::: {.callout-important title="Take heed!"}
The Mass setting for the Christmas season is the *Christmas Carol Mass* with *A Christmas Gloria*.
:::

### Hymns

All hymns are taken from the blue Gather hymnal unless otherwise noted. Note that the lyrics may not match our hymnal. Please practice the lyrics in the Gather hymnal, regardless of the video.
